item.title: Former Fredericksburg Commonwealth’s Attorney La Bravia J. Jenkins Passes Away at 72
item.description: The Honorable La Bravia J. Jenkins, who served as Fredericksburg's elected Commonwealth's Attorney for more than a decade, passed away over the weekend of February 28–March 1, 2026. She was 72. Jenkins died in Louisville, Kentucky, according to local reports.

item.title: 19-year-old Bristow man killed in fiery crash at I-66 rest area
item.description: A 19-year-old Bristow resident was killed Saturday afternoon when his Toyota sedan struck a parked tractor-trailer in an Interstate 66 eastbound rest area in Prince William County and burst into flames.

item.title: 16th Northern Virginia Housing Expo comes to Fairfax for the first time March 7
item.description: The 2026 Northern Virginia Housing Expo is coming to the city of Fairfax for its 16th annual event on Saturday, March 7, 2026, from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Fairfax High School, 3501 Lion Run, Fairfax. item.title: MCPS Proposes $175.4 Million FY27 Budget with 5.5% Average Pay Raise, $6.8M VAVA Partnership Boost
item.description: Manassas City Public Schools (MCPS) leadership presented an ambitious yet balanced $175.4 million proposed budget for Fiscal Year 2027 during the February 24, 2026, School Board business meeting, marking a 9.3% increase—or roughly $15 million—over the adopted FY26 budget.

item.title: Montgomery Launches Write-In Bid Amid Casim Controversy in Woodbridge Supervisor Race
item.description: In a dramatic turn for the Woodbridge District Supervisor special election, Pam Montgomery, a U.S. Army veteran, former Judge Advocate General (JAG) officer, lifelong Democrat, and experienced public servant, officially launched her write-in candidacy today.

item.title: Rubber Duck Race Revival Announced for Fredericksburg; Vote on Event Name
item.description: Fredericksburg rubber duck races will return after a hiatus.

item.title: Israel Mensah Wins Fredericksburg Regional Spelling Bee
item.description: Israel Mensah, a student from Stafford County Public Schools, claimed the championship title at the 2026 Fredericksburg Regional Spelling Bee on Saturday, February 28, at James Monroe High School in Fredericksburg.

item.title: A New Grocery Store near Dumfries?
item.description: “Sprouts is excited to bring our wide selection of fresh, local and better-for-you products to the Dumfries community as we continue to grow in Virginia,” Sprouts public relations manager Mychael Ramirez said in an email to the Prince William Times, the newspaper reported.

item.title: Prince William Supervisors Move to End By-Right Data Centers in Overlay District — But Approve Controversial Hornbaker Project in 4-3 Vote
item.description: In a split decision reflecting deep divisions over the county's data center boom, the Prince William County Board of Supervisors voted 4-3 on March 3 to initiate a zoning text amendment that would eliminate by-right approval for data centers inside the Data Center Opportunity Zone Overlay District and require special use permits (SUPs) for all future projects countywide.

item.title: Stafford Shields Data Centers from Tax Hike, Targets Homeowners
item.description: While advertising a six-cent increase in the real estate tax rate to $0.985 per $100 of assessed value for calendar year 2026—potentially adding about $430 annually to the average household bill—the Stafford County Board of Supervisors rejected a proposal to raise the personal property tax rate on data center computer equipment and peripherals from $1.25 to $2.50 per $100 of assessed value during its March 3, 2026 meeting.
